note: Breadcrumb Extra Field exposes the site breadcrumb as a display extra field ('breadcrumb') so it can be positioned among fields on Manage display. Setup is two steps: (1) enable an entity type/bundle in config breadcrumb_extra_field.settings:breadcrumb_extra_field_admin (nested map entity_type -> {bundle -> bundle|0}) via the form at /admin/config/system/breadcrumb-extra-field (perm 'administer breadcrumb extra field'); hook_entity_extra_field_info then exposes the hidden 'breadcrumb' display extra field; (2) place that field on the entity_view_display (setComponent 'breadcrumb'). hook_entity_view renders it from the core 'breadcrumb' service. Changing the config must invalidate the entity_field_info cache tag. No storage/plugins/services/Drush. Medium reads back which bundle is enabled; hard cases enable node/page in config and place the field on the Article display, verified live.

evals.prompt: What does the breadcrumb_extra_field Drupal module let you do that the theme's normal breadcrumb region does not, and how does the breadcrumb become positionable?
evals.expected_output: It adds the site breadcrumb as a display extra field ('Breadcrumb') on selected entity bundles, so you can drag it into any position on the entity's Manage display and print the breadcrumb between fields instead of only in the theme's fixed breadcrumb region.

evals.prompt: After enabling breadcrumb_extra_field, what are the steps to actually show the breadcrumb field on an Article page? Where is the settings form?
evals.expected_output: Two steps: (1) on the settings form at /admin/config/system/breadcrumb-extra-field, tick the entity type/bundle (e.g. node/Article) to enable the extra field; (2) on the Article Manage display, drag the now-available 'Breadcrumb' field out of Disabled into the content region and save.

evals.prompt: Which permission gates the breadcrumb_extra_field settings, and what config key stores the list of entity types/bundles that have the breadcrumb field enabled?
evals.expected_output: The permission is 'administer breadcrumb extra field'. Enabled entity types/bundles are stored in breadcrumb_extra_field.settings:breadcrumb_extra_field_admin, a nested map of entity_type -> { bundle -> bundle|0 }.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, for which entity type and bundle has the breadcrumb_extra_field breadcrumb been enabled? Inspect the live configuration.

On this Drupal site, use breadcrumb_extra_field to make the Breadcrumb extra field available on the 'Basic page' (node/page) content type's display (enable it for that bundle). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set breadcrumb_extra_field.settings:breadcrumb_extra_field_admin so node.page is enabled (e.g. ['node' => ['page' => 'page']]) and invalidate the entity_field_info cache tag (or drush cr); the 'breadcrumb' display extra field then appears on node/page.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Breadcrumb extra field is already enabled for the Article content type. Now make it actually show on Article pages by placing the Breadcrumb field into the content region of the Article default view display. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a 'breadcrumb' component to core.entity_view_display.node.article.default (e.g. $display->setComponent('breadcrumb', ['weight' => -40, 'region' => 'content'])->save(), or drag it out of Disabled on Manage display).
